item.description: A new Vermont State Police barracks is planned in Clarendon near Route one hundred three and Route seven. The project does not require an Act two hundred fifty permit. The new facility is expected to be completed in twenty twenty-seven.

Rutland City’s proposed budget for twenty twenty-seven-twenty-eight is nearly twenty-nine million dollars, up one point five million. The increase covers salaries and rising costs without adding new programs. Mayor Donahue prioritizes public safety and recreation services.

Linda McCuen of Proctor High School is Vermont's Teacher of the Year for twenty-twenty-seven. She has taught in Vermont for twenty-three years. McCuen will serve as an ambassador for educators statewide starting in January.

Stuff A Bus food drive runs November fifth to seventh in Rutland. Donations will support local food shelves and community organizations. The event honors longtime supporter Nanci Gordon, who passed away this year.
